candidates.source_name: NBS – Subjekty finančného trhu (financial market entities database)
candidates.why_relevant: Master licence database of the National Bank of Slovakia listing every supervised entity by sector – banks, branches of foreign banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, agents. This is the canonical generator of the Slovak banking/payments actor universe that every A2 tender-search cell must query names against.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of sector-filtered listing pages (query params aa=select_sector&bb=<n>); snapshot entity names + IČO into an actor master table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on NBS registers + snowball from nbs.sk registre index
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska register platobných inštitúcií zoznam dohliadaných subjektov
NBS zoznam bánk a pobočiek zahraničných bánk subjekty.nbs.sk sektor banky

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register podľa PSD2 (JSON API)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable daily-refreshed JSON of all Slovak PSD2 payment service providers (AISP/PISP/PIISP), payment institutions and e-money issuers with business name, address and IČO. Directly ingestible; the cheapest structured seed of payments-sector actor names for tender-name matching.
candidates.legal_status: official public register published under PSD2 Art.15
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled GET of /api/psd2 (plus /api/cl for institution-type codelist, /api/psd2signed for signed copy); diff daily to detect new/lapsed licences.
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched NBS PSD2 register documentation page
queries_used: zoznam poskytovateľov platobných služieb Slovensko licencia PSD2

candidates.source_name: NBS – Registre dohľadu (index of all supervision registers)
candidates.why_relevant: Hub page enumerating every NBS register (PSD2, creditors, financial agents, AIF managers, RBUZ, CERI, DORA register of information). Used to snowball to sub-registers that each define a slice of the financial actor universe.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly re-crawl of the index page to detect new registers; treat as a link-discovery seed rather than a data source.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska register platobných inštitúcií zoznam dohliadaných subjektov

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register finančných agentov a finančných poradcov (regfap)
candidates.why_relevant: Register of financial intermediaries/advisers – captures the distribution-layer actors (including bank-tied agents) that fall outside the licence register but often appear as counterparties or subcontractors in financial-sector procurement.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Form-driven scrape by sector/subject-type; low refresh cadence (quarterly).
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska register platobných inštitúcií zoznam dohliadaných subjektov
local_language_terms_used: register finančného sprostredkovania a finančného poradenstva

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register veriteľov (regver, consumer-credit creditors)
candidates.why_relevant: Lists licensed non-bank consumer-credit providers ('nebankovky'), an actor group adjacent to banking/payments that buys similar core-systems and card technology.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic listing export; join on IČO with business register.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska register platobných inštitúcií zoznam dohliadaných subjektov

candidates.source_name: NBS – DORA Register of Information (register informácií o zmluvných dojednaniach s ICT poskytovateľmi)
candidates.why_relevant: Under DORA, Slovak financial entities must report their ICT third-party service providers to NBS. Even if entity-level data is not published, the guidance/aggregate publications reveal which ICT vendor categories serve Slovak banks – a rare regulator-side pointer to the vendor universe behind bank IT procurement.
candidates.access_status: guidance public; underlying register likely non-public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the page and NBS/ESA publications for aggregated CTPP lists; do not assume entity-level data availability.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska register platobných inštitúcií zoznam dohliadaných subjektov

candidates.source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) – členovia
candidates.why_relevant: The single banking-sector association in Slovakia; its ~23 members cover >99% of the sector. The member list is the compact, curated buyer universe for A2 tender monitoring, and SBA positions/press releases signal sector-wide IT and payments initiatives.
candidates.legal_status: private association site; ToS review advised
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape members page semi-annually; cross-check against NBS bank list to catch non-members.
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia členovia zoznam bánk

candidates.source_name: Asociácia leasingových spoločností SR (ALS) – riadni členovia
candidates.why_relevant: Explicit member-listing page for ~32 leasing companies (bank-owned, captive and independent). Leasing arms are separate legal entities that run their own IT/payments procurement and often appear separately in tender and RPVS data.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape /riadni-clenovia and the board page annually; also harvest ALS press releases (PDF) for market-size context.
queries_used: Asociácia leasingových spoločností SR členovia zoznam

candidates.source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia (Slovak FinTech Association)
candidates.why_relevant: Interest association of Slovak fintech/payments companies; its membership and working groups reveal the challenger/vendor side of the payments universe (including Mastercard/Vacuumlabs-linked Bratislava FinTech Hub) that rarely shows up in NBS licence registers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape members/partners pages; supplement with FinStat entity record (IČO 51910497) and LinkedIn/Facebook feeds for member announcements.
queries_used: Slovensko fintech asociácia SAFA Slovak fintech association členovia payments

candidates.source_name: FINAS – Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia
candidates.why_relevant: Second, distinct Slovak fintech body (fintech + insurtech). Two competing associations means neither membership list alone is complete – both are needed to close the vendor-universe gap for payments and digital-finance suppliers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape membership page; deduplicate against Slovenská FinTech asociácia members.
candidates.discovered_via_method: same search as Slovak FinTech Association (snowball across results)
queries_used: Slovensko fintech asociácia SAFA Slovak fintech association členovia payments

candidates.source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS) – Ministry of Justice
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandatory register (Act 315/2016) for anyone receiving public funds or contracting with the state, including beneficial owners and authorised persons. It is the highest-yield pointer for A2: any bank, payment provider or IT vendor that wins Slovak public contracts must be registered here, so it both enumerates suppliers and links them to ultimate owners.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Advanced search by partner / beneficial owner; scrape partner detail pages for IČO, KUV, verification documents. Mirror via uvostat.sk RPVS listing when direct crawling is rate-limited.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball to Ministry of Justice and uvostat mirror
queries_used: register partnerov verejného sektora RPVS vyhľadávanie rpvs.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: Uvostat – RPVS partners listing (third-party mirror/aggregator)
candidates.why_relevant: Re-published, list-form view of RPVS entities alongside Uvostat's public-procurement analytics. Easier bulk enumeration than the official RPVS UI, and cross-links companies to their actual tender wins.
candidates.legal_status: third-party re-publication; verify against official RPVS before citing
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginated scrape for supplier enumeration; always re-verify individual records against rpvs.gov.sk.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result snowball from RPVS query
queries_used: register partnerov verejného sektora RPVS vyhľadávanie rpvs.gov.sk
local_language_terms_used: zoznam firiem z registra partnerov verejného sektora

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Zoznam hospodárskych subjektov (list of registered economic operators)
candidates.why_relevant: Public Procurement Office's register of economic operators that have proven personal-standing conditions – effectively a pre-qualified bidder universe valid for three years. Directly answers 'who bids for Slovak public contracts', the core actor question for A2.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the list and join by IČO to bank/fintech/IT-vendor actor tables; also crawl the companion Register verejných obstarávateľov for the contracting-authority side.
queries_used: register hospodárskych subjektov ÚVO zoznam uchádzačov uvo.gov.sk evidencia

candidates.source_name: Obchodný register SR (ORSR) + Ministry of Justice open data dumps
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative company register giving legal names, IČO, statutory bodies and ownership for every Slovak bank subsidiary, payment institution and IT vendor. The IČO from ORSR is the join key that links licence registers, RPVS and tender award notices into one actor graph.
candidates.access_status: public web search; no official REST API (pilot Swagger at obcan.justice.sk reported)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer bulk open-data dumps published by justice.gov.sk (reported weekly SQL exports) over HTML scraping; fall back to per-IČO extract pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on open data + snowball
queries_used: obchodný register ORSR.sk data.gov.sk otvorené dáta register právnických osôb RPO API

candidates.source_name: Register právnických osôb (RPO) – reference register with REST API
candidates.why_relevant: RPO is the state reference register consolidating commercial, trade and association registers; documented as having an official REST API. It is the most complete single source of legal-entity identity for Slovak actors and the cleanest programmatic entry point for building the actor master list.
candidates.access_status: API access documented via Slovensko.Digital ecosystem catalogue; official endpoint terms to be confirmed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the Slovensko.Digital open-API/open-data catalogue to locate the current RPO v2 endpoint, then batch-resolve IČOs; re-check endpoint stability each quarter.
queries_used: obchodný register ORSR.sk data.gov.sk otvorené dáta register právnických osôb RPO API

candidates.source_name: ORSF – open REST API aggregating Slovak state company registers
candidates.why_relevant: Free, no-key REST API claiming to consolidate ~14 Slovak state registers (RPO, ORSR, RÚZ, VAT lists) for 1.25M+ entities under CC-BY 4.0. A pragmatic bulk-resolution layer for actor names -> IČO when official APIs are awkward; must be treated as secondary to official registers.
candidates.legal_status: CC-BY 4.0 claimed by operator; attribution required
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use api.orsf.sk for name/IČO resolution and enrichment; spot-verify a sample against ORSR before relying on it.
queries_used: obchodný register ORSR.sk data.gov.sk otvorené dáta register právnických osôb RPO API

candidates.source_name: Register účtovných závierok (registeruz.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory financial-statement register for all Slovak accounting entities, searchable by IČO/name/LEI. Confirms that an actor exists, is active and at what scale – essential for filtering the actor list down to entities big enough to run meaningful tenders, and for sizing vendors named in award notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Batch lookups by IČO on /domain/accountingentity/search and /domain/financialstatement/search; annual refresh after statement filing deadlines.
queries_used: registeruz.sk register účtovných závierok IT asociácia Slovenska ITAS členovia zoznam

candidates.source_name: IT Asociácia Slovenska (ITAS) – members
candidates.why_relevant: Largest Slovak ICT industry association; its members are precisely the systems integrators and IT vendors that bid on bank and public-sector technology tenders. Supplies the supply-side half of the A2 actor universe that financial licence registers cannot provide.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the members directory semi-annually; join by IČO to ÚVO economic-operator list to flag members active in public tenders.
queries_used: registeruz.sk register účtovných závierok IT asociácia Slovenska ITAS členovia zoznam

candidates.source_name: Republiková únia zamestnávateľov (RÚZ) – members
candidates.why_relevant: Peak employers' body whose members span banking, insurance and the IT sector, and which includes sectoral associations as members. Useful as an association-of-associations pointer that surfaces smaller sector bodies not otherwise indexed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape members page once; extract member associations as new pointer seeds. Cross-check EU Transparency Register (lobbyfacts) entry for positions.
queries_used: Republiková únia zamestnávateľov RÚZ členovia zoznam asociácie

candidates.source_name: Slovenská asociácia finančníkov (SAF)
candidates.why_relevant: ~218-member body of CFOs, treasurers, banks, financial institutions and explicitly 'financial and software providers/consultants'. Its membership and event sponsors expose the corporate-treasury and treasury-software vendor layer relevant to payments procurement.
candidates.access_status: public pages; parts behind a members zone
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape membership, bodies and cooperation pages; harvest event/sponsor pages for vendor names. Member-zone content is out of scope.
queries_used: Slovenská asociácia finančníkov členovia treasury banky zoznam asocfin.sk

candidates.source_name: EBA EUCLID – Credit Institutions Register & PSD2 Payment Institutions Register (SK filter)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level cross-check on the Slovak actor universe: lists SK-authorised credit and payment institutions plus inbound passporting entities that serve Slovakia from other Member States and therefore never appear in an SK-only register. Closes the cross-border blind spot in the actor list.
candidates.access_status: public search UI; bulk downloads offered by EBA
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download CIR and PIR extracts filtered to home country SK plus host country SK; diff against NBS PSD2 JSON to detect passported-in providers.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register euclid Slovakia payment institutions passporting list

candidates.source_name: FinStat.sk – Slovak company intelligence aggregator
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator combining ORSR, registeruz, VAT and debtor lists into one entity profile. Fastest way to enrich an actor name with IČO, revenue, ownership and links to public-sector contracts; used here to confirm association legal identities (e.g. Slovak FinTech Association IČO 51910497).
candidates.legal_status: commercial ToS – scraping likely restricted; API/licence route preferred
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume lookups or a paid API licence; do not bulk-scrape. Prefer official registers for systematic collection.
queries_used: Slovensko fintech asociácia SAFA Slovak fintech association členovia payments
registeruz.sk register účtovných závierok IT asociácia Slovenska ITAS členovia zoznam

candidates.source_name: Banky.sk – zoznam bánk na Slovensku (consumer portal directory)
candidates.why_relevant: Non-official but conveniently structured directory of Slovak banks and of the SBA itself, useful as a quick alias/brand-name table (trading names vs legal names) for text-matching bank names in tender notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off scrape to build a brand-name/alias lookup; never use as an authoritative universe.
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia členovia zoznam bánk

negative_findings.description: Neither the Slovenská FinTech asociácia nor SAF exposed a scrapable, complete member list in search results; SBA's exact member roster page was also not directly surfaced (only the aggregate '23 members / >99% of the sector' statement on the About page).
negative_findings.result_summary: Association identities and URLs confirmed, but member rosters need direct on-site navigation or an email request to the secretariat (sekretariat@slovakfintech.sk).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-side actor coverage for A2 stays incomplete until these rosters are captured; missing vendor names means missing tender award matches.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for a dedicated card/payments industry association (analogue of a national card association or ATM/POS operators' body) and found none; the space appears to be covered by SBA, the two fintech associations and ITAS.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Slovak card/payments-specific trade association identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no single membership list that enumerates POS/ATM/acquiring vendors; that universe must be assembled from ITAS, fintech associations and tender award notices instead.

negative_findings.description: ORSR has no confirmed official public REST API; reporting points to a pilot Swagger at obcan.justice.sk and weekly SQL dumps at justice.gov.sk/sluzby/registre/otvorene-data. Neither was fetched or verified in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk access route for the commercial register is plausible but unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Actor-graph construction depends on IČO joins; if bulk access is unavailable, per-entity scraping raises cost and blocking risk.

negative_findings.description: The DORA 'register informácií' collects each financial entity's ICT third-party providers, but no evidence was found that NBS publishes entity-level contents.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the framework/guidance page appears public.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Would otherwise be the single best map of who supplies IT to Slovak banks; its likely confidentiality means vendor mapping must rely on tenders and association lists.

coverage_gaps.description: Member rosters of SBA, Slovenská FinTech asociácia, FINAS, ITAS and RÚZ were identified by URL but not individually fetched and parsed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse each members page, normalise names to legal entity + IČO via ORSR/RPO, and store as the A2 actor master list.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment/e-money providers passported into Slovakia from other Member States will not appear in SK-only registers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull EBA EUCLID PIR/CIR with host-country=SK and merge with the NBS PSD2 JSON.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell concentrated on supplier/actor registers; the contracting-authority side (ÚVO Register verejných obstarávateľov, state IT bodies, municipalities, Štátna pokladnica) was only touched via one URL.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicate a follow-up pass to enumerating financial-sector-relevant contracting authorities and their ÚVO profiles.

coverage_gaps.description: No searches were run for stavebné sporiteľne, credit unions, crypto/VASP registers, or the Slovak Association of Insurance Companies, each of which may carry its own membership or licence list touching payments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run local-language queries for 'stavebné sporiteľne zoznam', 'register poskytovateľov služieb virtuálnych mien', 'Slovenská asociácia poisťovní členovia'.

brief: Slovakia's actor universe for banking and payments is unusually well served by statutory registers: NBS publishes both a sector-browsable supervised-entity database and a machine-readable daily PSD2 JSON feed, while the Ministry of Justice's RPVS makes registration legally compulsory for anyone contracting with the state, and ÚVO maintains a pre-qualified list of economic operators. Together these four give a near-complete, join-ready supplier and licence-holder list keyed on IČO, with ORSR/RPO and registeruz.sk supplying identity and scale, and EBA EUCLID closing the cross-border passporting gap. The association layer is fragmented — one banking association (SBA, ~23 members covering >99% of the sector), one leasing association (ALS, ~32 members), two competing fintech bodies (Slovenská FinTech asociácia and FINAS) and ITAS for IT vendors — so no single roster covers the vendor side and several must be merged. The main outstanding work is mechanical: fetch and parse the individual membership pages and confirm bulk-access routes for ORSR/RPO, since no dedicated Slovak cards/payments trade association appears to exist to shortcut that vendor mapping.
